production.note: US model years. First: Porsche's US release of 18 July 2024 ("The 2025 Porsche Panamera Turbo S E-Hybrid and Panamera GTS") says both "are now available to order and are expected to reach U.S. Porsche Centers in late Q1 2025." Still on sale: porsche.com/usa lists the 2027 Panamera GTS (porsche-usa-panamera-gts-2027). The 971 Panamera models are separate records.

body.note: Porsche: "the Panamera GTS is a dynamic sports sedan"; a four-door liftback (C/D panel: "4-passenger, 4-door hatchback"), recorded as Sedan as in the 971 Panamera record. No Sport Turismo is sold on the 976.

configuration.note: Panel: "twin-turbocharged and intercooled DOHC 32-valve V-8, alumnium block and heads, direct fuel injection" (sic).

aspiration.note: "Both models are powered by the further developed 4.0-liter twin-turbo V8 engine".

fuel.note: porsche.com/usa: "2027GasolineAll-wheel-driveAutomatic" for the GTS; Motor Authority: "The GTS skips electrification" (motorauthority-panamera-gts-tseh-2024).

drivetrain.note: Panel: "Vehicle Type: front-engine, all-wheel-drive, 4-passenger, 4-door hatchback"; porsche.com/usa: "All-wheel-drive" (porsche-usa-panamera-gts-2027).

transmission.note: "The 8-speed Porsche dual clutch transmission (PDK) has been significantly improved." Panel: "8-speed dual-clutch automatic". DCT is Porsche PDK; no manual is offered.

powerHp.note: Panel quote: "Power: 493 hp @ 6500 rpm". Manufacturer: "The engine delivers 368 kW (493 hp), 20 hp more than its predecessor." (porsche-us-panamera-gts-tseh-2024); porsche.com/usa, 2027 model: "Max. engine power 493 hp" (porsche-usa-panamera-gts-2027).

weightLb.note: Car and Driver road-test curb weight (weight-order step 2), 2025 model, 8-speed PDK (the only transmission). Panel quote: "Curb Weight: 4676 lb". The test car carried options (panel lists rear-axle steering, insulated glass, carbon trim and others), so a standard car may be slightly lighter. No Porsche Cars North America curb weight was found: the release gives none and the porsche.com/usa technical-data section did not render.
